_comment: P5 Health Check CLI — server list example. Pass this file with: ./p5_health_check.sh -c /path/to/this/file.json. Without -c, the script auto-detects in order: /Users/Shared/P5Servers.json, /Users/Shared/P5HealthCheckServers.json, ~/Documents/P5Servers.json, ~/Documents/P5HealthCheckServers.json. Passwords are never stored here — the script reads from Keychain or prompts interactively. Supported top-level shapes: { "servers": [ ... ] } or [ ... ].
